function: Learns one-bit column-wise RIS phase configurations (MAPPO, statistical CSI) and a DL model replacing WMMSE for BS precoding, maximizing sum spectral efficiency (p. 3).
system: Downlink MU-MISO: BS with M=8 antennas, K=2 single-antenna users; passive reflecting RIS, one-bit, column-wise, L=4 sub-surfaces of 8x8 elements; band not stated (p. 1; p. 2; p. 4).
method: MAPPO reinforcement learning (CTDE), one agent per sub-surface; supervised DL model trained on labeled BS-precoding data; extension reuses pretrained actors (p. 2; p. 3; p. 4).
data_channel: Simulated Rician channels (K1=K2=5 dB, K3=2 dB), distance-based path loss; 1,200 SCSI sets, 1,000 training, 200 testing; no 3GPP or measured data (p. 2; p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained at P=10 dBm, L=4; tested at P from 2 to 22 dBm; RIS size N=128 to 384 via retraining or extension reusing pretrained agents (p. 4; p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: continuous SSCA-WMMSE [4], one-bit quantized SSCA, random RIS, no RIS; learned: QMIX-WMMSE (QMIX [10] replaces MAPPO); variants MAPPO-DL, Extension-DL (p. 4).
metrics: Sum spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz) versus transmit power and RIS size; convergence over training episodes; running time (ms) and relative performance (Table II) (p. 4; p. 5).
complexity: Complexity orders (MAPPO-DL O(T_H IKM + IKN + L I^2), MAPPO-WMMSE, SSCA) and running times: SSCA 4556 ms, MAPPO-DL 0.67 ms (Table II, p. 5).
openness: none; no code or data link in the letter (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "Considering the Rician fading channel model, the channels" - a custom Rician simulator with its own path-loss exponents (p. 4); no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "we only require training on the newly introduced" - pretrained actors are reused for a larger RIS and only the new agents are trained (Extension-DL, N=128 to 384, Figs. 3 and 5); the transmit-power sweep of Fig. 4 is not counted.
q3_support: p. 5: "the QMIX algorithm, the MAPPO algorithm achieves nearly" 8% performance improvement - QMIX [10] is a standard multi-agent RL algorithm run in the same framework; the non-learned SSCA and Random RIS are compared on SE in Figs. 4 and 5.
q4_support: p. 5: "exhibits a much lower computational complexity of" - orders are given for SSCA, MAPPO-WMMSE, and MAPPO-DL, with running times in Table II (SSCA 4556.07 ms, MAPPO-DL 0.67 ms).
q5_support: p. 4: "1,200 SCSI sets are simulated, with 1,000 sets allocated for" - training and test data come from the authors' own simulation; no code or data link, public dataset, or measurement is given.
notes: Area 3: the RIS sub-surface phases are learned with MAPPO and, in the extension, the BS precoding is learned by a DL model replacing WMMSE (p. 3). q2 rests on the Extension-DL adaptation (only the new agents are trained, p. 4). q3 counts QMIX, a standard multi-agent RL algorithm inside the same framework, as the learned baseline; the reviewer should confirm.
